title: [review] messaging.py:119: No validation of sender identi
description: render_post validates body/text and id fields but does not validate the 'from' field. A malicious client can POST messages with arbitrary or missing 'from' values, enabling sender spoofing. If downstream code trusts the 'from' field for authorization or display, this is a security gap.
close_reason: Fixed 3 issues: (1) Strip user-supplied 'from' field to prevent sender spoofing; (2) Deep copy message before passing to registrar callback to prevent mutation affecting inbox; (3) Deep copy message in deliver() to isolate inbox entries. Unbounded receipts was already fixed via _max_receipts trimming.
